import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import numpy as np
from online_matching.train_rf import training_matrix, train_backup, tree_certificate, backup_predict
random.seed(3)
bad=0
for trial in range(40):
    width = random.randint(2,16)
    n = random.randint(1,60)
    rows = [{'class': random.randrange(random.randint(1,5)), 'values': [random.choice([0,1,700,1513,1515,1600,2000,3028,1514]) for _ in range(random.randint(0,width+2))]} for _ in range(n)]
    X,y = training_matrix(rows, width)
    m = train_backup(X,y)
    nodes = tree_certificate(m)
    for _ in range(200):
        x = [random.choice([0,1,700,1513,1515,1600,2000,3028,1514]) for _ in range(width)]
        mine = backup_predict(nodes, x)
        theirs = int(m.predict(np.asarray([x], dtype=np.int32))[0])
        if mine != theirs:
            bad+=1; print('MISMATCH', x, mine, theirs); break
print('backup prediction mismatches:', bad)
# depth / node sanity
print('sample certificate', tree_certificate(train_backup(*training_matrix([{'class':0,'values':[1,2]},{'class':1,'values':[3,4]},{'class':0,'values':[5,6]}], 2))))
